blocks.title: Rectification
blocks.text: AC (alternating current) ko DC (direct current) mein badalne ke amal ko rectification kehte hain.

Diode current ko ek simt mein guzarne deta hai (forward bias) aur ulti simt mein rok deta hai (reverse bias). Rectification do qism ki hai: half wave aur full wave. Computer aur smartphone jaise aalaat ko mustaqil (stable) DC chahiye, jab ke ghar aur dukanon ki bijli AC hoti hai; is liye in mein rectification istemal hoti hai.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Mobile phone AC jama karta hai ya DC? Phone ki battery DC jama karti hai, kyunke DC ko jama karna AC se aasan hai, aur DC zyada mehfooz bhi hai. Bijli ka grid sirf AC deta hai, is liye phone, laptop ya torch charge karne se pehle rectifier AC ko DC mein badalta hai.
Diode bataur rectifier

Forward bias mein diode bara current guzarne deta hai, lekin reverse bias mein current taqreeban zero hota hai. Diode ki isi khaas khoobi ki wajah se ise rectification ke liye istemal karte hain, yani AC ko ek-rukhi (unidirectional) current, yani DC, mein badalna.
Half-wave rectifier

Half-wave rectification mein AC signal ka ek aadha cycle guzarta hai aur doosra aadha rok diya jata hai; is tarah pulsating (jhatkon wala) DC milta hai. Fig. 17.13 mein period T ka alternating voltage (input voltage) ek diode D ko diya gaya hai jo load resistance R_L ke saath series mein hai. Diode current ko sirf ek simt mein jane deta hai, is liye AC signal DC signal ban jata hai. Fig. 17.13 circuit aur input/output waves dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: transformer diode D (forward resistance rf) aur load resistor RL ko series mein deta hai; current I, load current Idc aur output voltage Vdc nishan zada. Neeche baen: AC voltage input signal, 0, 90 aur 180 darje. Neeche daen: DC voltage output signal; musbat aadhe chakkar guzarte (conducting) aur manfi aadhe chakkaron mein output sifar (cut off).
blocks.caption: Figure 17.13: Half-wave rectifier ka kaam, input aur output waves graph par (kitab ki Figure 17.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke output graph mein negative aadhe cycles bhi bane hue hain, halanke diode unhein rok deta hai. Sahi output un hisson mein zero hai; khaake mein yeh hisse sirf halki dashed lakeer se dikhaye gaye hain ke input kya tha.

Input ke positive aadhe cycle (waqt 0 se T/2) mein diode D forward bias hota hai: is ki resistance bohat kam hoti hai aur R_L mein current behta hai. Is current se R_L par voltage banta hai jo input ke saath upar neeche hota hai (Fig. 17.13).

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye (For your information)
blocks.text: Kitab half-wave rectifier ke circuit board ki tasveer dikhati hai, jis par us ke mukhtalif parts (transformer, diode, capacitor waghera) lage hain.

Negative aadhe cycle (waqt T/2 se T) mein diode reverse bias ho jata hai aur bohat zyada resistance deta hai, is liye R_L mein taqreeban koi current nahi aur us par voltage taqreeban zero hota hai. Agle cycles mein yahi dohraya jata hai. R_L mein current sirf ek simt mein behta hai, yani DC hai, lekin jhatkon (pulses) mein. R_L par aane wale voltage ko output voltage kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Block diagram: 220 V AC rectifier mein, phir battery, phir inverter aur aakhir mein AC appliance. Rectifier ke neeche battery charger us ka output le kar battery ko deta hai. Note: rectifiers are used in UPS at homes for backup power.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.13 (a): Hamare gharon mein use hone wale UPS ka circuit view (kitab ki Figure 17.13 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bijli aane par rectifier AC ko DC banata hai aur charger battery charge karta hai. Bijli jane par battery ki DC inverter mein ja kar dobara AC ban jati hai aur appliance chalta rehta hai.
Full-wave rectification

Jis rectification mein input AC ke dono aadhe cycles resistance mein ek hi simt ka current bhejte hain, use full-wave rectification kehte hain. Yeh bridge rectifier se hoti hai: chaar diodes ek band 'bridge' (pul) ki shakal mein jore jate hain. Transformer ki secondary winding bridge ke ek taraf aur load doosri taraf juri hoti hai. Chaar diodes D₁ se D₄ 'series pairs' (jori) mein hain: har aadhe cycle mein sirf do diodes current chalate hain (Fig. 17.15(a)).

blocks.alt: Chaar diodes D1 se D4 ka bridge; konay A (oopar) aur B (neeche) AC source V se jure; baqi do konay load R par +V aur 0V dete, darmiyan DC output. Current I source se A ki taraf aur B se wapas, aur +V lakeer par load ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.15 (a): Chaar diodes aur load resistance wala full-wave bridge rectifier circuit (kitab ki Figure 17.15 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Positive aadha cycle: diode sirf forward bias mein current chalata hai. Supply ke positive aadhe cycle (0 se T/2) mein bridge ka terminal A, terminal B ke muqable positive hota hai. Ab D₁ aur D₂ forward bias ho kar series mein current chalate hain, D₃ aur D₄ reverse bias hain, aur current load resistance R mein se guzarta hai (Fig. 17.15(b)).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text:
PN junction diode ke istemal:
1. Rectification
2. Signal clipping (signal ka hissa kaatna)
3. Regulation (voltage qaboo)
4. Clamping voltage
5. Signal detection
6. Photovoltaic (solar) cells
7. Switching aur roshni nikalna (LED)

Negative aadha cycle: (T/2 se T) terminal A negative aur B positive hota hai. Ab D₃ aur D₄ series mein current chalate hain aur D₁, D₂ reverse bias ho kar band (OFF) ho jate hain. Load mein current pehle wali simt mein hi behta hai (Fig. 17.15(c)). Figs. 17.15(b) aur (c) ka muqabla karein: dono aadhe cycles mein load mein current ki simt ek hi hai. Yani input ke dono aadhe hisse load mein ek-rukhi current bhejte hain. Output hamwar (smooth) nahi balke pulsating hai; capacitors wale filter circuit se ise hamwar kiya ja sakta hai. Mobile phone chargers mein aam taur par full-wave bridge rectifier hota hai jo deewar ke socket ka AC, battery charge karne ke liye DC mein badalta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: input wave, 0 se 4 pi. Oopar daen: teen output pattiyan: D1 aur D2 conducting (pehle aur teesre aadhe chakkar mein pulse), D3 aur D4 conducting (doosre aur chauthe mein), aur final output jis mein har aadhe chakkar mein pulse. Neeche: musbat aadhe chakkar (0 se T/2, D1 aur D2, sabz teer) aur manfi aadhe chakkar (T/2 se T, D3 aur D4, gulabi teer) mein bridge; dono dafa load R mein current neeche ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.15 (b), (c): Full-wave bridge rectifier musbat aur manfi aadhe chakkaron mein, input aur output waves ke saath (kitab ki Figure 17.15 (b), (c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke graphs par 'Half wave Bridge rectifier' likha hai. Bridge rectifier full-wave rectifier hai: har aadhe cycle mein do diodes chalte hain aur final output mein har aadhe cycle ka pulse hota hai; khaake mein yahi dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Mains input step-down transformer se guzarta hai jis ki secondary (oopar +, neeche -) chaar diodes ke bridge ko deti hai. Chalne wale do diodes gulabi hain aur gulabi lakeer current I ko un se aur load se neeche earth tak dikhati hai. Chhote khaake AC input (aik aadha chakkar surkh) aur 0 V ke oopar full-wave output (pehla pulse surkh) dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.16 (a): Mobile charger mein full-wave bridge rectifier ka circuit (kitab ki Figure 17.16 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ek smoothing capacitor ke saath full-wave bridge rectifier

AC se DC banate waqt rectification ke baad ripple voltage (bacha hua upar neeche) kam karne ke liye smoothing filters lagate hain. Rectified output pulsating DC hota hai jo zyada tar electronic aalaat ke liye theek nahi. Smoothing filter AC hisson (ripples) ko chhaant kar ziyada mustaqil DC dete hain. Capacitor filter mein capacitor load ke parallel laga hota hai: rectified voltage barhe to capacitor charge hota hai, ghate to discharge ho kar load ko current deta hai; is tarah output hamwar ho jata hai.

Smoothing (reservoir) capacitor output ke paar load ke parallel laga hota hai. Yeh energy jama karne wale aale ki tarah kaam karta hai aur average DC output ko aur ooncha kar deta hai (Fig. 17.17). Yun rectifier ka full-wave ripple wala output kaafi hamwar DC ban jata hai. Capacitor ki qeemat badal kar output wave par is ka asar dekha ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: full-wave bridge rectifier (D1 se D4, A aur B par AC source) aur +V aur 0 V ke darmiyan load R ke aar-paar smoothing capacitor C; sabz teer aik aadhe chakkar aur surkh teer doosre mein current dikhate. Neeche: nateeja wave; capacitor ke baghair dashed pulses, aur capacitor ke saath Vdc ke qareeb taqreeban seedhi lakeer jo C charge hone par uthti aur discharge hone par aahista girti hai, chhota ripple chhorti.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.17: Smoothing capacitor rectifier ke full-wave ripple wale output ko hamwar DC voltage mein badalta hai (kitab ki Figure 17.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 17.17 par 'Soothing capacitor' aur 'Wafeform' chhapa hai, aur dono teeron par 'with capacitor' likha hai. Sahi: smoothing capacitor aur waveform; oopar wali mazboot lakeer capacitor ke saath ki wave hai aur dashed pulses capacitor ke baghair ki.
Full-wave bridge rectifier mein sab se zyada ripple voltage frequency, load current aur smoothing capacitor teeno par munhasir hai:

blocks.text_alt: V_ripple = I_DC/(f_ripple C)   or   V_ripple = I_DC/(2fC)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke ripple voltage smoothing capacitor ki qeemat par munhasir nahi, sirf frequency aur load current par hai. Lekin usi ka formula V_ripple = I_DC/(2fC) batata hai ke C barhane se ripple kam hota hai. Sahi: ripple C, f aur load current teeno par munhasir hai.
Yahan I_DC load current (ampere), f input frequency aur C capacitance (farad) hai. Ripple frequency input frequency ki dugni hoti hai (har aadhe cycle mein ek pulse):

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Hamara dil bijli ke pulses se dharakta hai. AC current ki frequency dil ki dharkan ki frequency ko bigar sakti hai aur heart attack (dil ka daura) ka sabab ban sakti hai; is liye AC ka jhatka khatarnak hai.

blocks.title: Izafi misal (kitab mein nahi)
blocks.problem: 50 Hz supply par full-wave bridge rectifier 2000 μF ke smoothing capacitor ke saath 0.5 A load current deta hai. Ripple voltage nikalein.

blocks.prompt: Full-wave rectifier ka output half-wave se zyada aasani se hamwar kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Full-wave mein pulses dugni dafa aate hain (ripple frequency 2f), is liye capacitor ko pulses ke darmiyan discharge hone ka aadha waqt milta hai, aur usi capacitor ke saath ripple taqreeban aadha reh jata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Rectification: diode se AC ko DC banana (forward bias mein current guzarta hai).
Half-wave: ek diode, sirf ek aadha cycle; full-wave bridge: chaar diodes, dono aadhe cycles.
Load ke parallel smoothing capacitor; V_ripple = I_DC/(2fC), f_ripple = 2f.
